narrative: During this period, epenet merged fewer PRs while significantly increasing review output and line volume. Merged pull requests dropped by 21.8%, but reviews given increased by 55.6% alongside larger median PR sizes, indicating a shift from direct code authorship toward code review and larger items.
root_cause_hypothesis: Fewer PRs while reviews rise: time moved to reviewing

evidence_chain.claim: Median PR size increased by 26.7 percent
